_about: The client has no glossary, so this file is the term list. Each term names where its text comes from: `tooltip` (a tooltip id, giving the title and description), or `term_key` / `definition_key` (text keys). `term` and `definition` are written by hand only where the client has no text, and win over the client when both exist. `category`, `aliases` and `seeAlso` are always editorial. Keys of the form `<kind>:<refId>` are clarifications shown above an item's game text.
